summary: Sono Group N.V. filed this 8-K/A to report the sale of its entire interest in wholly-owned subsidiary Sono Motors GmbH. On May 4, 2026, the company entered into a Share Purchase and Transfer Agreement with two purchasers who are the subsidiary’s managing directors, selling 100% of the shares for an aggregate price of €1.00, and also assigning shareholder loan repayment claims of ~€10.5 million for an additional €1.00. The transaction closed immediately with no conditions precedent. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The divestiture appears to be a distressed exit to management. Watch for potential related-party scrutiny and the company’s restructuring plans.
